message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy | Contact | |---------|---------|------------|---------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Miami Central Station)** | 1 SE 1st Street, Miami, FL 33131 | • Pets are allowed in the station’s public areas (e.g., waiting rooms, ticket counters).
• On Tri‑Rail and Amtrak trains, pets must be in a carrier or on a leash and must not disturb other passengers.
• No pets in the dining or retail areas. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [Tri‑Rail](https://www.tri-rail.com) / [Amtrak](https://www.amtrak.com) | ### Why this station is a good choice 1. **Central Location** – It’s the main hub for both Tri‑Rail (regional commuter service) and Amtrak (long‑distance service), so you’ll have plenty of train options. 2. **Pet‑Friendly Facilities** – The station’s design includes wide corridors and ample seating, making it easy to navigate with a pet. 3. **Convenient Amenities** – Nearby there are pet‑friendly cafés and a small pet store, so you can grab a quick snack or a treat for your furry friend. 4. **Accessibility** – The station is fully ADA‑compliant, with elevators and ramps that accommodate strollers, wheelchairs, and pets in carriers. ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Your Pet - **Carrier** – Keep your pet in a well‑ventilated carrier that fits under the seat or in the designated pet area on the train. - **Leash** – If your pet is not in a carrier, keep them on a short leash and close to you at all times. - **Clean Up** – Bring a small bag for waste disposal; the station has designated trash receptacles. - **Check Train Rules** – Some trains have specific pet rules (e.g., no pets on certain routes or during peak hours). Verify ahead of time on the Tri‑Rail or Amtrak website. Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details on pet policies for specific trains or additional nearby pet‑friendly spots!
